homeFaction._comment: below are original faction init code. if generator specified a location, then mainExit and floors data will be dropped. do faction read data from template? can we keep the same factionID without using the floor config?

scopeConditions._comment: we will need this for when we create a family and want them to say live in hotel while preserving the family hierarchy -> in this case it will mean the family will have their home created but vacent.
scopeConditions._comment3: we use scopeconditions so we dont have to hardcode factionID and this will allow generator to automatically fill in job slots in the world wherever that is.

TempHomefactions._comment: if force, character always satisfy membertype requirement (such as skill req) and will be upgrade to it. if false, then check character actual skills.

scopeConditions._comment: list of conditions to find a valid faction with valid membertypes. for example, day time/ night time job, what type of job (doctor/conveniencestore)

workFactions._comment: if force, character always satisfy membertype requirement (such as skill req) and will be upgrade to it. if false, then check character actual skills.

activityFactions._comment: subscribe to activities, for example gym membership
